newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says no defence links concluded with Iran.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says no defence links concluded with Iran.

text.p: NATO member Turkey said on Monday it had no definite plans for defence industry cooperation with neighbouring Iran despite talks on the subject this month that worried Washington.
"In that context we have neither any project nor any contract," foreign ministry spokesman Omer Akbel told a news briefing.
He said defence industry cooperation was not discussed during a visit to Turkey last week by Iranian President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani.

The United States urged Ankara not to enter into military joint efforts with Tehran after Turkey's Islamist prime minister, Necmettin Erbakan, discussed possible defence industry projects with Iranian Deputy Foreign Minister Alaeddin Boroujerdi on December 10.
Turkey and Iran signed several economic accords last week following top-level talks in defiance of U.S. bids to isolate Iran.
